content:
As I understand it, you want to start with a fresh install with no carryovers. I assume you use Windows. Do this:

  1. enter %appdata% in the search box on task bar and press enter key
  2. this should open file explorer at appdata\roaming folder
  3. delete the thunderbird folder there
  4. download and install thunderbird from thunderbird.net. the installation will create a new thunderbird folder for you
